decisions.thought: Incineroar's Intimidate and Fake Out give tempo against the opposing physical attackers. Garchomp is the fastest threat on our side, and Gholdengo's special power covers Dragonite and Primarina. Together they cover the opponent's Dragon, Water/Fairy, and Steel types.

Incineroar and Garchomp seem like strong picks for utility and speed, while Gholdengo covers special attacks, though I need to consider how Archaludon handles their Dragonite and Primarina threats.

Mirror Incineroar lead, I am faster at 80 Speed vs 60 base. Fake Out will flinch them before their Fake Out lands.
